class.name: IfcRelFillsElement
class.brief_description: IfcRelFillsElement is an objectified relationship between an opening element and an element that fills (or partially fills) the opening element. It is an one-to-one relationship. NOTE view definitions or implementer agreements may restrict an opening to be filled by one filling element only.
